notes.title: Project Pulsation: vote on Greenlight
notes.content:
Hi all,

[b]Cubic Bundle[/b] is proud to present a new indie game by Vitaly Gintsar - [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=545342392]Project Pulsation[/url]

[url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=545342392]Project Pulsation[/url] is a sci-fi horror FPS with stealth elements.


[h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=545342392]VOTE[/url][/h1] for Project Pulsation on Greenlight and we will make sure to include the game in our bundle!

notes.title: Version 1.0.4
notes.content:
We heard you like options, so we put some options in your options, so you can choose options while you play.

Another small pretty update for those you who:
- Hated 'КИСЛОРОД' screen
- Hated scanlines
- Likes to see how many times Yury died

Enjoy the rage quits.

[img]http://i.gyazo.com/7bc18630f2c278084541d63f25724c6c.png[/img]

notes.title: Yury - update
notes.content:
Hello everyone, thank you for your feedbacks on the game.
We have just released a new [b]update 1.0.2[/b] for you with following features:
[list]
[*]Resolution change
[*]Windowed/full screen mode option
[*]Controls re-mapping
[*]Joystick support
[/list]

[img]http://i.gyazo.com/900e9335c45eeb9e90fe2c1ac74a238a.png[/img]

We hope this will make game experience more enjoyable!
